Their main challenges include finding beginner-friendly instructions, creating a suitable program, and selecting compatible hardware for reliable internet connectivity. Despite considerable effort, they remain confused and frustrated about building the required logic, pointing to a lack of accessible guides or practical examples for newcomers.
